findings.title: Declare return types on exported functions
findings.message: The exported function `computeLineTotal` in src/billing/helpers/compute-line-total.ts must have an explicit return type annotation. While the function body includes a return statement with a typed object, the function signature should explicitly declare the return type `InvoiceLine` to provide a clear contract for consumers and prevent silent type changes during refactoring.

claims.claim: The exported function `computeLineTotal` in src/billing/helpers/compute-line-total.ts has an explicit return type annotation.
claims.reason: The diff shows the function signature at line 5 of the new file: `export function computeLineTotal(item: LineItem): InvoiceLine {`. This clearly includes an explicit return type annotation of `InvoiceLine` after the colon.

claims.claim: The return type annotation on the exported function `computeLineTotal` is `InvoiceLine`.
claims.reason: The diff shows the function signature explicitly declares the return type as `InvoiceLine`: `export function computeLineTotal(item: LineItem): InvoiceLine {`.

claims.claim: The function body of `computeLineTotal` includes a return statement with a typed object.
claims.reason: The diff shows the function returns an object with properties `sku`, `description`, and `amount` (lines 13-16). The types of these properties are inferred from the `InvoiceLine` type based on the function's return type annotation.
